outcome: neonatal morbidities (cardiovascular involvement, hematological involvement, congenital anomalies, preterm birth, intrauterine growth restriction, resuscitation requirement, complete atrioventricular block, esophageal atresia)
neonatal demographic data (birth weight, gestational age)
cohort: The study included 57 Turkish mother-infant pairs where mothers had Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).
finding: The study found a notable incidence of adverse neonatal outcomes among infants born to mothers with SLE, including preterm birth (15.8%), intrauterine growth restriction (14%), and rare congenital anomalies such as complete atrioventricular block and esophageal atresia.
